artifact.title: Re: Substitution Update - Order MA-EXP-2026-014
artifact.body:
Dear Sofía,

Thank you for your patience regarding the substitution for the missing Peony varieties in order MA-EXP-2026-014.

Status: Approved.
The replacement shipment (15 stems of 'Sarah Bernhardt' Peonies) has been cleared by our export desk. The new delivery window is Thursday, January 8, 2026, between 10:00 and 12:00.

Next Step: Please confirm with your logistics team if the receiving dock is accessible for a quick drop-off outside the main refrigerated unit, given the ongoing maintenance on your cold room. We cannot guarantee the integrity of the flowers if they are held in a non-temperature-controlled environment for more than 2 hours.

Best regards,

Oliver Kent
Export Support Employee
Mar Azul Export Desk
Case Ref: MA-EXP-2026-014-SUB
